# Browser dependency artifacts

These versioned packages make the public source checkout installable without a
Registry source checkout or live Registry server.

- `ocno-oryn-protocol-0.1.0.tgz` is regenerated by the root `./scripts/bootstrap`
  from the included Protocol source. Do not edit the package independently.
- `ocno-oryn-registry-0.1.0.tgz` supplies the compiled Registry library, schemas and
  baseline model catalog. Original Registry implementation and catalog work are
  licensed under MIT. Registry source maintenance is separate from this source
  distribution; runtime catalog refresh installs no package code.
- Diffusers and MFLUX wheels are built from the reviewed source revisions and
  hashes recorded in the Browser `packaging/` manifests. Their original upstream
  licenses and embedded notices remain part of the wheels.
- `oryn_depth_native` contains reviewed Depth Anything 3 numerical sources with
  their Apache-2.0 license. The Engine source manifest records the exact inputs.
- The Oryn MFLUX provider is first-party MIT code; its source is included under
  the Engine's `providers/mflux/` directory.

Only the explicitly selected dependency versions belong in a public export.
Keep artifact identities, consumer lockfiles and verification metadata in sync.
Changing a candidate archive does not replace bytes in an already published
package version. See the root [dependency notices](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
